name: Abusive Husbands
overview: Scripture calls husbands to love their wives sacrificially and without bitterness, following the example of Christ's love for the church (Ephesians 5:25; Colossians 3:19). Abusive behavior contradicts this divine mandate and disrupts the honor and purity of marriage, which God values highly (Hebrews 13:4). Wisdom encourages gentle speech to defuse anger and warns against the strife that comes from harsh words and contemptuous attitudes (Proverbs 15:1; Proverbs 22:10). Christ’s teaching on marriage underscores its sacredness and the responsibility husbands bear to uphold it with love and respect (Mark 10:2).
